payload.title: Agents and operators manage shapes and file shaped stories through the CLI
payload.description: As an agent or operator using the papyrus CLI over SigV4, I can list, create and update content shapes and create or update a story with a shape, so a publication is fully configurable without the UI. Acceptance: papyrus shapes list/show/set (create-only import from a file outside the repo, never overwriting edits), papyrus stories create/update --shape, JSON output.
